verses.text: Paul, an apostle (sent one) of Jesus Christ by the will of God. I am sent according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus.
To Timothy, my beloved (dearly loved) son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers (ancestors) with pure conscience. Without ceasing (stopping) I have remembrance of you in my prayers night and day.
I greatly desire to see you, being mindful (remembering) of your tears. Then I may be filled with joy.
I call to remembrance the unfeigned (not pretended) faith that is in you. It dwelt (lived) first in your grandmother Lois, and your mother Eunice. And I am persuaded (sure) that it is in you also.
So I put you in remembrance (mind) of this. Stir up the gift of God, which is in you. It came by the putting on of my hands.
For God has not given us the spirit of fear. God has given us the spirit of power, and of love, and of a sound (healthy) mind.
So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me His prisoner. But be partaker (sharer) of the afflictions (troubles) of the gospel (good news). Do it by the power of God.

God has saved us, and called us with a holy calling. It was not according to our works (the good things we do). It was according to His own purpose and grace. This grace was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began.

But now it is made manifest (plain to see) by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ. Christ has abolished (done away with) death. He has brought life and immortality (life that never dies) to light through the gospel (good news).
For the gospel (good news) I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle (sent one). I am a teacher of the Gentiles (people who are not Jews).

For this cause I also suffer these things. Nevertheless I am not ashamed. For I know whom I have believed. I am persuaded (sure) that He is able to keep what I have committed to Him. He will keep it against that day.
Hold fast the form of sound (healthy) words, which you have heard of me. Hold them in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
Keep that good thing which was committed to you. Keep it by the Holy Spirit which dwells (lives) in us.
You know this, that all those who are in Asia have turned away from me. Phygellus and Hermogenes are among them.
May the Lord give mercy to the house of Onesiphorus. For Onesiphorus often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain.
But when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently (carefully), and found me.
May the Lord grant that Onesiphorus finds mercy of the Lord in that day. You know very well how many things he ministered (served) to me at Ephesus.
You therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
You have heard things of me among many witnesses. Commit (hand over) the same to faithful people, who will be able to teach others also.
You therefore endure hardness (hard things), as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
No one who wars entangles themselves with the affairs of this life. They want to please the one who has chosen them to be a soldier.
And if anyone strives for masteries (competes in games), they are not crowned unless they strive lawfully (by the rules).
The husbandman (farmer) who labours (works hard) must be first partaker (sharer) of the fruits.
Consider what I say. And the Lord give you understanding in all things.
Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead. This is according to my gospel (good news).
For the gospel (good news) I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even to bonds (chains). But the word of God is not bound.
So I endure all things for the elect's (chosen people's) sakes. Then they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
It is a faithful saying: For if we are dead with Him, we will also live with Him.
If we suffer, we will also reign with Him. If we deny (say we do not know) Him, He also will deny (say He does not know) us.
If we believe not, yet He abides (stays) faithful. He cannot deny Himself.
Put them in remembrance (mind) of these things. Charge (command) them before the Lord not to strive about words. It is to no profit (help). Such striving subverts (overturns) the hearers.
Study (work hard) to show yourself approved to God. Be a workman that does not need to be ashamed. Rightly divide (correctly handle) the word of truth.
But shun (stay away from) profane (godless) and vain babblings (empty talk). For they will increase to more ungodliness.
And their word will eat as does a canker (spreading sore). Hymenaeus and Philetus are of them.
Concerning the truth they have erred (missed the mark). They say that the resurrection (rising from the dead) is past already. They overthrow the faith of some.
Nevertheless the foundation of God stands sure, having this seal (mark): The Lord knows those who are His. And: Let everyone who names the name of Christ depart from iniquity (sin).
But in a great house there are not only vessels (containers) of gold and of silver. There are also vessels (containers) of wood and of earth (clay). Some are to honour, and some to dishonour.

So if anyone purges (cleans) themselves from these, they will be a vessel (container) to honour. They will be sanctified (made holy), and meet (useful) for the master's use. They will be prepared to every good work.

Flee (run away from) also youthful lusts (wrong desires). But follow righteousness (being right with God), faith, charity (love), peace. Follow them with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
But avoid foolish and unlearned questions. You know that they gender (start) strifes (quarrels).
And the servant of the Lord must not strive (quarrel). The servant of the Lord must be gentle to all people, apt (able) to teach, patient,
In meekness (gentleness) instructing those who oppose themselves. God may perhaps give them repentance (a change of heart). Then they may come to the acknowledging (knowing) of the truth.
And they may recover themselves out of the snare (trap) of the devil. They are taken captive (prisoner) by him at his will.

verses.text: This know also, that in the last days perilous (dangerous) times will come.
For people will be lovers of their own selves, covetous (greedy), boasters (braggers), proud, blasphemers (people who speak against God). They will be disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
Without natural affection, trucebreakers (people who break promises), false accusers, incontinent (without self-control), fierce, despisers (haters) of those who are good,
Traitors, heady (reckless), highminded (proud), lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God.
They have a form of godliness, but deny the power of it. From such turn away.
Of this sort are those who creep into houses. They lead captive (prisoner) silly women laden (loaded) with sins, led away with divers (many) lusts (wrong desires).
These women are ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
Jannes and Jambres withstood (stood against) Moses. In the same way these also resist the truth. They are men of corrupt (rotten) minds, reprobate (worthless, rejected) concerning the faith.
But they will proceed no further. For their folly (foolishness) will be manifest (plain to see) to all people, as theirs also was.
But you have fully known my doctrine (teaching), manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering (patience), charity (love), patience,

Persecutions (attacks for faith), afflictions (troubles), which came to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra. You know what persecutions (attacks for faith) I endured. But out of them all the Lord delivered (rescued) me.
Yes, and all who will live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution (being attacked for faith).
But evil men and seducers (deceivers) will wax (grow) worse and worse. They will deceive (fool), and be deceived (fooled).
But continue in the things which you have learned and have been assured of. You know of whom you have learned them.
From a child you have known the holy scriptures. They are able to make you wise to salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

All scripture is given by inspiration of God (breathed out by God). It is profitable (helpful) for doctrine (teaching), for reproof (showing what is wrong), for correction, for instruction in righteousness (being right with God).
Then the man of God may be perfect (complete), thoroughly furnished (fully equipped) to all good works.

verses.text: I charge (command) you therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ. He will judge the quick (living) and the dead at His appearing and His kingdom.
Preach the word. Be instant (ready) in season, out of season. Reprove (correct), rebuke (scold), exhort (encourage) with all longsuffering (patience) and doctrine (teaching).
For the time will come when they will not endure sound (healthy) doctrine (teaching). They will heap to themselves teachers after their own lusts (wrong desires), having itching ears.
And they will turn away their ears from the truth. They will be turned to fables (made-up stories).
But watch (stay alert) in all things, endure afflictions (troubles), do the work of an evangelist (one who tells the good news). Make full proof of your ministry (serving).
For I am now ready to be offered (poured out). The time of my departure is at hand (near).
I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course (race), I have kept the faith.

From now on there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness (being right with God). The Lord, the righteous (fair) judge, will give it to me at that day. He will give it not to me only, but to all those who love His appearing.
Do your diligence (best) to come shortly to me.
For Demas has forsaken (left) me, having loved this present world. Demas has departed to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.
Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with you. For he is profitable (useful) to me for the ministry (serving).
And I have sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
When you come, bring the cloke (coat) that I left at Troas with Carpus. Bring the books also, but especially the parchments (writings on animal skin).
Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil. May the Lord reward him according to his works.
Beware of him also. For he has greatly withstood (stood against) our words.
At my first answer (defense) no one stood with me, but all forsook (left) me. I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.

Notwithstanding (even so) the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me. The Lord did this so that by me the preaching might be fully known. He did it so all the Gentiles (people who are not Jews) might hear. And I was delivered (rescued) out of the mouth of the lion.
And the Lord will deliver (rescue) me from every evil work. He will preserve (keep) me to His heavenly kingdom. To Him be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Greet Priscilla and Aquila, and the household (family) of Onesiphorus.
Erastus abode (stayed) at Corinth. But I have left Trophimus at Miletum sick.
Do your diligence (best) to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brothers.
The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
